items.summary: Amazon.com, Inc. (NASDAQ:AMZN) founder and executive chairman Jeff Bezos is planning to sell up to 15 million Amazon shares worth approximately $4.07 billion. Bezos’ Amazon Stock Sale Is Tied to a Prearranged Trading Plan A Form 144 filing submitted to the Securities and Exchange Commission on Monday showed that Bezos intends to sell 15 million shares of Amazon common stock through Morgan Stanley Smith Barney LLC. items.title: Stocks mixed as Seoul stabilises, oil prices rise with eyes on Mideast
items.summary: Stocks stabilised in Asia on Tuesday after last week's tech-led rollercoaster ride as investors tracked a record day on Wall Street, while oil prices edged up after their recent plunge with Donald Trump and Iran giving conflicting views on peace talks.Oil prices rose around one percent, having plunged five percent Monday, on hopes for a US-Iran deal to reopen the Strait of Hormuz.
